# Karim Eldib Law Firm (مكتب المحامي كريم الديب للمحاماة)

> Egyptian law firm founded in 2006, led by lawyer Karim Eldib. Main office in Alexandria, branch in Sharm El Sheikh. Practice areas: international arbitration and mediation, legal services for foreigners in Egypt, company formation and corporate law, family, civil, commercial and criminal law, and services for Egyptians abroad. Languages: Arabic, English, French, Italian.

- Main office: 29 El Masalla Gharb & Sherif Pasha St., El Attarin, Alexandria, Egypt
- Branch: Sharm El Sheikh, South Sinai, Egypt
- Phone / WhatsApp: +20 122 376 7592
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- The site is published in Arabic (default, at the root) and English (under /en).
